user_query: My family and I are planning a game night filled with laughter. Help us gather some programming memes to kick off the fun and search Reddit comments for recommendations on the best multiplayer games to play. It would be great if you can also find some interesting Reddit posts about game night success stories.

TaskList.description: Search for popular programming memes on Reddit.
Search Reddit comments for recommendations on the best multiplayer games.
Find Reddit posts about game night success stories.
